jobs.prompt: Create premium anatomical fitness illustration for BODYWEIGHT STANDING CALF RAISE, exercise ID1373, adult male variant. Use attached illustration for approved artistic style only, not its squat pose. Two equal panels side by side, white background, full figure and equipment inside own panel with white margins. REAR THREE-QUARTER view so backs of both calves and heel-floor gaps are clearly visible. Same man/camera/clothes/scale in both panels. A simple light gray wall in front of man, both palms lightly touching wall at shoulder height for balance. Feet shoulder width toes pointing forward, knees straight but not locked, torso upright. LEFT PANEL: both heels fully on floor, feet flat. RIGHT PANEL: both heels elevated 5-7cm, weight through balls of feet/toes staying on floor, neutral ankle alignment, no rolling outward or inward; body lifted vertically, calves shortened, same hands on wall. Highlight both gastrocnemius muscle bellies RED on posterior lower legs only; not shins, ankles, thighs or shoes. Grayscale detailed anatomy realistic proportions with crisp definition on exposed arms/calves. Wear opaque black sleeveless training shirt fully covering torso and black knee-length shorts with COMPLETE REAR SEAT, front, sides, crotch, seams and folds, shoes; real clothing covers anatomy entirely with no transparent patches. Soft contact shadows consistent lighting. NO text, numbers, labels, arrows, logos. Not a video. Show toes and heels clearly; do not crop feet.
